# Lamp (`equipment:lamp`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md) | **Cost:** 5 sp | **Weight:** 1 lb.

A Lamp burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 15- foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet
